Condition: NOTE 1:If different SMTC periodicities are configured for different cells, the SMTC period in the requirement is the one used by the cell being identifiedNOTE 2:When DRX is not configured, LPSS/SSS is the number of SMTC occasions not available at the UE during TPSS/SSS_sync_intra_CCA for PSS/SSS detection, where LPSS/SSS< LPSS/SSS,max. When DRX is configured, LPSS/SSS is the number of DRX cycles in which at least one SMTC occasion is not available at the UE during TPSS/SSS_sync_intra_CCA for PSS/SSS detection, where LPSS/SSS< LPSS/SSS,max.
